workstreams.name: Software TLB optimisation and safe translation reuse
changes: core/mmu.h: permission- and page-checked read-span reuse; no independent translation cache
core/memop.c: avoid repeated RAM resolution on helper reads
Real MMU/helper regression added for warm read reuse, page crossing, remap invalidation and distinct PAN rights
exceptions: The hot tag and addend loads enforce current mapping identity and EL/PAN rights. Removing them or adding independently cached pointers would bypass the existing invalidation contract. Reuse validated TLB RAM read spans instead; preserve writes and precise smaller-granule fallback.
planned_validation_evidence: test_mmu: real warmed helper, page crossing, remap and PAN; test_optimization_primitives: bounds/EL/PAN
test_mem: native-vs-JIT scalar/pair/vector/atomic paths

workstreams.name: Grouped memory access and fast-path consolidation
changes: core/translate.c: preserve grouped spans across ADD/SUB Xn,Xn immediate
tests/mem_programs.S: increment, decrement, scalar/pair and page-crossing fallback
exceptions: Grouped code retains its original cold fallback and explicit experimental activation. Existing upstream measurements found no general speedup with about 15 percent emitted-code growth; the new increment shape is checked with paired native benchmarks before any default change.
planned_validation_evidence: test_mem: four execution modes including grouped increments and page-crossing fallback
test_bench: paired HV_GROUPS=0/1 native/JIT code shapes

workstreams.name: Idle wakeup attribution and elimination
changes: ios/Henge/EngineTuning.swift: activate existing deadline-aware secondary-CPU kicks; CPU0 I/O cadence unchanged
host/vm.c and core/machine.c: atomic CPU0/due/unknown/deferred timer-kick attribution; explicit kicks bypass filter
planned_validation_evidence: test_idle_ticker: TSAN generation cancellation and lost-wakeup checks
test_idle_integration and test_timer_dispatch: due/future/unknown deadlines and explicit kicks
test_vm_lifecycle with HV_DEADLINE_KICKS=1

workstreams.name: Damage-driven Metal and unchanged-frame suppression
changes: devices/cursor_damage.h and pvg_metal.m: exact unchanged cursor suppression; retain authoritative guest swaps
exceptions: A shared scanout can be changed by guest CPU writes outside GPU resource epochs. Mapping identity or unchanged exec counts therefore cannot safely suppress an authoritative swap. Keep dirty-event presentation, latest-frame coalescing and exact cursor suppression without extra CPU frame hashing/readback.
planned_validation_evidence: test_optimization_primitives: exact cursor damage key and hidden cursor normalization
test_pvg_lifecycle: real queued Metal work/quiescence and draw target restoration

workstreams.name: Retina and cursor efficiency
changes: devices/display_settings.h: coherent cursor/pacing/thermal cache, notification updates
BootDisplay.swift: retain physical scale through reparenting and avoid unchanged color/alpha writes
planned_validation_evidence: test_display_settings: 200000 cached reads perform zero defaults lookups; live policy notifications/concurrent readers
test_display_router: folded/monitor routing, coalescence, stale refresh cancellation and layer replacement

workstreams.name: JIT cache residency and memory pressure
changes: host/reclaim_pages.h and core/dispatch.c: reclaim dead block metadata only after global cache quiescence; preserve executable mappings
Memory warnings trim only unowned Metal library and excess Link pixel-buffer/texture cache resources; live guest surfaces retained
exceptions: Debugger-granted executable mappings may not be reacquired after detachment. Reclaim retired metadata after a global barrier, never live JIT aliases or guest RAM. Keep allocation boundary pages untouched and disable advisory metadata reclamation while the asynchronous profiler may inspect records.
planned_validation_evidence: test_optimization_primitives: MADV_FREE boundaries/overflow/reuse under ASan/UBSan
test_chain_index: 100000 links and global reset
test_metal_library_cache: trim retains live function owners
test_pvg_lifecycle: memory trimming ordered on renderer worker

workstreams.name: Superblock and flush configuration
changes: EngineTuning.swift: clear removed overrides; retain conservative superblock default and full publication barriers
exceptions: Retain full publication/invalidation barriers and switch-flush correctness. ASID reuse can leave stale kept mappings if switches elide invalidation. Superblocks, grouped accesses and TLB preloading remain explicit experiments unless repeatable native evidence supports a default change.
planned_validation_evidence: test_stw_flush, test_jit, test_jit_region and superblock checks: publication/invalidation under cache exhaustion
test_engine_tuning: actual defaults, removed overrides and experimental activation

workstreams.name: A20 scheduling and guest-vCPU configuration
changes: Retain equal responsive vCPU QoS and explicit guest CPU count; eliminate avoidable secondary timer kicks instead of demoting guest CPUs
exceptions: Equal responsive vCPU QoS preserves device CPU and inter-vCPU invalidation acknowledgement latency. Demoting arbitrary guest CPUs can cause priority inversion. QoS cannot guarantee physical core placement; no cloud test establishes four vCPUs as the optimal device workload setting.
planned_validation_evidence: tools/check_host_scheduling.sh: native QoS plans and SDK checks
test_cpu_sync and deadline-enabled lifecycle: acknowledgement and worker preservation

changes: BootDisplay.swift: track actual window identity and scale as well as size
DisplayRouter.swift: coalesce fold/rotation refreshes and cancel stale refresh tasks
DisplayRouter.swift: immediate same-identity layer replacement and repeated attachment suppression
planned_validation_evidence: test_display_router: connection priority, coalesced refresh, immediate replacement and stale task cancellation
test_display_snapshot: both ports, malformed/truncated records

workstreams.name: Link inactive-viewer and streaming efficiency
changes: LinkProtocol/Service/Views/Video: inactive visibility messages, epoch retirement, skip hidden capture/encode and request latest on return
Negotiate viewerVisibility in the existing ready message; new viewers never send optional controls to legacy protocol-2 hosts
planned_validation_evidence: tools/link/check.sh: real hardware codec/pixel/TLS/credits/Keychain and SDK UI checks
test_link: hidden capture suppresses frame, memory trim and visible return; three modes including odd native dimensions
Protocol-2 legacy ready and older viewer schema coexist with negotiated visibility; capability list bounds checked

workstreams.name: Integrated thermal-aware policy
changes: display_settings.h/pvg_metal.m: thermal notifications feed the single existing presentation policy; quality-changing caps remain explicit opt-in
exceptions: Optional thermal presentation caps can reduce smoothness, so they remain user-controlled and off by default. Safe automatic work elimination uses deadline filtering, dirty events, hidden Link suppression and cache trimming without silently changing Retina, resolution, selected refresh or vCPU count.
planned_validation_evidence: test_display_settings: coherent selected caps and thermal opt-in state; foreground notification refresh
test_pvg_lifecycle and pacing checks: single presenter/cap policy
